subject: Pilot kickoff alignment for Velocity AI — next steps & access
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@velocity.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff alignment for Velocity AI — next steps & access

Hi Olivia (and team),

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. I wanted to capture the key points, success criteria, and immediate asks so we have a single source of truth before we spin up the pilot environment. Short version up top: Redwood can scope a two-week initial pilot (chat + batch embeddings) that demonstrates 60%+ cost improvement on your high-volume inference path and meets a 95th percentile latency target under 200ms for the chat endpoint.

Recap of pain & goals:
- Pain: production chat workload has high per-request cost and inconsistent latency at peak; current infra spikes cause timeouts for agents.
- Goal: reduce inference cost on the chat path by ~50-70% while keeping P95 latency <200ms for interactive queries; also validate vector search accuracy for re-ranker use-case.

Proposed pilot scope (initial):
- Endpoints: 1) live chat endpoint (interactive, streaming), 2) nightly batch embeddings job (up to 200k docs).
- Dataset: a 5k-document sample and 10k chat traces (sanitized) for prompt-eval and regressions.
- Eval suite: 20 canonical prompts + 60 edge-case prompts for quality/regression monitoring.
- Success metrics: cost per 1k tokens, P95 latency for chat, embedding throughput (docs/hour), and qualitative pass rate on prompt-evals (>85% pass threshold).

Owners & roles:
- Redwood: Rishi (deal/CS liaison), Priyom (onboarding / infra), Stephanie (SRE/observability hooks).
- Velocity AI: Olivia (PM, pilot owner), Max (CTO, security touchpoint).

Timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): sign pilot charter and share sample data + grant read-only S3 role for dataset access.
- Week 1: infra & model config, prompt/eval lab, initial integration of embeddings job.
- Week 2: performance tuning, cost regressions, joint demo and acceptance check.

Immediate asks from Velocity AI (action items):
1) Share the 5k document sample (sanitized) and 10k chat traces by EOD Monday (2026-09-13).
2) Create an IAM role with read-only S3 access to s3://velocity-pilot/samples and add redwood-pilot@redwood.example.com.
3) Confirm any network constraints (eg. IP allowlist or VPC peering) — we attached a short network worksheet.

Attachments (attached to this message): pilot-charter-template.docx, network-access-worksheet.xlsx

Next steps I can take: draft a short pilot charter (1 page) and a runbook for onboarding access. Priyom — can you confirm expected time to provision the test infra (GPU cluster + endpoints) once we have S3 role?

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for our kickoff slot (suggested: Wed 2026-09-15 10:00 PT).

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.example.com | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff alignment for Velocity AI — next steps & access

Rishi — thanks, this is great and aligned with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications and asks from our side: 

1) Data egress / residency: we need to confirm that no PII leaves our AWS account for this pilot. We can provide a sanitized dataset (will scrub PII) but the embedding/processing should happen in our VPC. Do you support a VPC private deployment or a connector approach?

2) SOC 2 / security questionnaire: we'll need to run a short questionnaire before granting the S3 role. I attached a redlined SOW we often use internally — we prefer a 30-day pilot with an option to extend.

3) Timeline: Sep 15 kickoff works for Olivia/Max. If you can provision a simple staging endpoint that accepts streaming chat and a batch job for embeddings, we can begin smoke tests within 48 hours of the kickoff.

Forwarding: I also looped in Max for any security/infra questions.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Product Lead, Search & Assistant | Velocity AI
olivia@velocity.ai | +1 212-555-0137
